text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this scenery...
It really feels like I've come home.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it feels so surreal.
To have you here in my castle!"
choice_data_list: Y-Yeah...
Y-Yeah...

text_block_list.text: ――It all started a few days ago.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
How about we go on a trip together sometime?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"There's a place I want to go with you.
When I asked the Captain, she even gave permission, saying she'd draw up an appropriate security plan♪"

I readily agreed, thinking it would surely
become a wonderful memory for Fine Motion, but...
choice_data_list: I can't believe our destination is Ireland...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no need to be nervous, okay?
Make yourself at home and relax.
Just kidding—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I might be a little nervous, too.
I haven't invited people to my room
very often, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My bookshelf and stuff are still the same as back then,
so it's a little embarrassing—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"How nostalgic!
I read this fairy tale so many times!"
choice_data_list: Is that a book filled with memories?
Is that a book of memories?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. When I was young,
I couldn't really leave the castle much.
So I was completely engrossed in reading.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. Would you like to read it too if you want?

"Upon opening the book, there was an illustration of a fairy.
However, because the text was in English,
I couldn't understand the details..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Once upon a time, there was a fairy girl living in a certain forest. She was quite mischievous, and would cast magic upon the villagers who visited—"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this fairy is just so cute! After this,
she meets a village girl, and then—

After she told me about the fairy tale,
she invited me to take a walk around the castle grounds.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I never thought I'd get to chat
with you about that fairy tale!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I spent so much time searching
for fairies, wondering if there might even be some in this garden!"
choice_data_list: With nature this lush, it really feels like they could exist.
With so much nature around, it really feels like they could exist, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it? I'm sure
we just can't find it.
It's always hiding somewhere!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
For example...
In the shadow of that gorse tree over there!

She pointed to a flowering plant.
Taking a closer look...
choice_data_list: Huh, this has kind of a mysterious scent.
Huh, this has kind of a mysterious scent.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it has a sweet scent just like candy, doesn't it?
It's a plant you see quite often
back in Ireland.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, should I introduce you to other plants?
You might get to meet even more flowers you've never seen before!
choice_data_list: Yeah, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Phew! We sure walked a lot.
Well now... are the preparations finished yet, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Head Maid
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, Trainer.
Tea has been prepared.
Also, please take these garments.
choice_data_list: Huh!? Is this...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah, wonderful!
That wool morning coat suits you perfectly♪
choice_data_list: To think you prepared formal attire like this for me...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah, wonderful!
That silk afternoon dress suits you perfectly♪
choice_data_list: To think you prepared formal attire like this for me...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Since I invited you to the castle,
I wanted to give you an experience you can only have here. ...What do you think?
choice_data_list: It's nothing but precious experiences, you might find yourself getting excited.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
! A precious experience, huh.
...Fufu, then I suppose this trip is a huge success.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It means I was able to show you
plenty of brand-new sights, after all."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Just like you did for me.
choice_data_list: Me, to you...?
Me... for you...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Right! It's because you were there that my world opened up.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The many wonderful sights I encountered in Japan.
The unforgettable pounding of my heart—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "Because if it were just me alone, I never would have found it."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
This trip is
a gift of gratitude from me to you.
choice_data_list: A gift for me—
A gift for me—

text_block_list.text:
"Will I continue to encounter new things together with her?
Things I didn't know, sights I've never seen before.
...Just like on this trip."
choice_data_list: Let's keep expanding our world together.
I'm sure I'll never forget this trip.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Together, huh?
...Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: There's no other prime seat quite as wonderful as this one♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Enjoying tea with you in a castle like this... It almost feels like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. Hey, I have a little request...
Would you dance with me later?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Since we're at the castle and all,
there are so many things I want to do with you♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it a lovely courtyard?
Back when I lived in the castle, I used to love enjoying tea while gazing out at the courtyard like this.
choice_data_list: So this is the view that you were seeing.
So this is the view you've been seeing...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly.
...This is my world, the one I wanted to show you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Phew—
choice_data_list: Feeling a little tired?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, maybe so.
Did I let loose a little too much?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"So, how about we take a nice, relaxing break...
and have a little chat? Fufu♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
My! What an honor.
To receive such wonderful words from you♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
In that case... next time,
maybe I'll look forward to being escorted by you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"So, where will you be taking me next?
...Fufu♪"
